confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied Kuala Lumpur, Yogyakarta and Manila figures; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Food, drink and hostel anchors are more reliable; hotel anchors vary widely by district and season. Cocktail and wine are not based on direct Penang bar prices: they follow the beer anchor at about 2x (cocktail) and 1.75x (wine), because direct knowledge is weak and alcohol prices vary by venue and tax.
comparable_city_reasoning: Penang is priced against Kuala Lumpur as the same-country comparable: food, drink and hostel anchors sit about 7 to 14 percent below KL, and hotel anchors about 19 to 23 percent below. Yogyakarta and Manila were used only to bracket the regional range, not as direct anchors.
